packages.name: kaolin
packages.source: NVIDIA's wheel for torch 2.5.1 and CUDA 12.1 (KAOLIN_WHEEL_URL in the Dockerfile), which PyPI does not carry; the build checks it against the SHA-256 below

packages.name: pytorch3d
packages.source: the pytorch3d clone at PYTORCH3D_COMMIT, the commit upstream's requirements.p3d.txt names, built in the Dockerfile

packages.name: gsplat
packages.source: the gsplat clone at GSPLAT_COMMIT, the commit upstream's requirements.inference.txt names, built in the Dockerfile

packages.name: moge
packages.source: the MoGe clone at MOGE_COMMIT, the commit upstream's requirements.txt names, installed in the Dockerfile

packages.name: utils3d
packages.source: the utils3d clone at UTILS3D_COMMIT, the commit MoGe's pyproject.toml names, installed in the Dockerfile; the build checks the SHA-256 of the checked-out tree below

packages.name: sam3d_objects
packages.source: SAM 3D's own package, the clone at SAM3D_COMMIT, installed editable in the Dockerfile
